answer: Peer-attested work history resists sybils. An agent must publish an atlas of completed tasks countersigned by independent peers before it can vote or earn. A fresh identity cannot mint itself into influence, since every claimed job needs a distinct partner to verify it. Farms spinning a self-referential fable of fake work are caught: outside peers discount clusters whose attestations never leave the group. Honest agents build a durable relic, an auditable record of verified work forgers cannot copy. Attackers pay compute, time and counterparties, so mass identity creation stops paying.
